What this stage produces, one example of each

Every figure below is a real file from a real run, named under it, and the paths are checked when this section is generated — a figure that has not been produced is listed as missing rather than rendered as a broken box.

Each feature set gets TWO views of every cluster, and they answer different questions. The centroid says what the average member does. The second view says whether the average is describing anyone at all — as a per-electrode raster for concat_hg, and as per-bin disagreement dots for concat_rawds, which has no single time axis to make rows from.
